# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | Yes       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open public issues for vulnerabilities.

Use GitHub Security Advisories:
- https://github.com/dhunanyan/task-flow-board/security/advisories/new

Or contact:
- info@dhunanyan.com
